details.name: The Berber Dynasties
details.author: hossein81 and marcokistan
details.description: Thirteen scoped art variants for Tribal Market, Tlemcen and Marrakech landmarks, Mosque, Siege Workshop and standard Keep. Gameplay and unrelated 0.3.0 members preserved.
details.changelog: Market's active Byzantine annex references removed; six Berber building families have donor-remodelled Age II-IV art. 0.3.0 remains the rollback.
